caseSchema.diagnosticVector: Ordered list of [severity,code,field,message,value]; full dataclass diagnostics also retained in beforeResult/afterResult
caseSchema.originalRaw: Exact input bytes encoded base64 before parse, descriptor exact; parsed ordered raw graph retained separately
caseSchema.provenance: Logical original ResourceSource/source_path reused for before/after; actualExportLocation null, no rebase or file facade

transport.name: TAGGED_TUPLE_TRANSPORT_V1_JSON_ARRAYS_NOT_P0_OBJECTS
forms: dataclass=["dataclass",original type symbol,ordered array of [field name,snapshot]]
transport.perHelperSnapshotSemanticBudget: 100000 nodes and depth64; dict keys and raw path string sidecar count
transport.generatedAggregateBudget: Every generated tagged tuple/list container and scalar/tag/type/field-name item intended for retained snapshots; excludes plain envelope/context/expected-vector/YAML/base64 metadata and transient comparator snapshots
transport.parserQualification: Whole capture guarded at96; existing worker uses ConvertFrom-Json -Depth100. No256-depth support claim.
transport.failedCounterQualification: Positive generatedTransportItems<=200000; failure may honestly record200001 because increment precedes rejection. Counter is generated work, not proof omitted failure-cap material was retained.

failureCriteria.caseFailure: Keep actually obtained bounded values, explicit failed stage/type/message<=512, dependent stages NOT_RUN; stop further cases; actualCaseCount honest, nonzero exit
failureCriteria.preBindingOrImportFailure: May have no capture; process/stream receipts remain truthful
failureCriteria.captureCapOrDepth: Write finite failure envelope with results empty, observed counts, caseFailureSummaries, captureCapExceeded/captureDepthExceeded and explicit omitted material; never PASS

collectorCompletion.stdout: Exactly one JSON line after capture closure, same fields on failure if capture closed; process exit distinguishes failure

sourceAndGo: Actual acceptedP0/checkpoint prerequisite satisfied only by root record; future exact source/data/freeze/permission/positiveSOURCE/rootadmission/separateGO remain UNBOUND; no authority here
failureRetentionOrder: Observed before/after hasErrors and diagnostic vectors are assigned before whole-result snapshot calls; a snapshot failure does not erase those obtained facts. Per-case Exception catch records FAIL/stage/type/message, stops cases, never retries or falls back to PASS.
